logoStyles.name: Måla flater
logoStyles.prompt: Painterly faceted illustration in the exact visual world of the reference mascot: broad painted volume planes, gently irregular thick dark contour, warm natural materials, restrained grain, friendly and dimensional without photorealism.

logoMotifs.name: Duldord
logoMotifs.prompt: Exactly FIVE blank square word-game tiles arranged in one compact slightly curved row, with one simple magnifying glass overlapping a corner. The five individual tiles must be clearly countable. No letters or markings on the tiles.

logoMotifs.name: Klassekart
logoMotifs.prompt: A simple classroom seating layout viewed from above: exactly three large desks, each with a small chair shape, arranged on a compact room plan, plus one clear location pin. Recognizable classroom planning, no people, animals or text.

logoMotifs.name: Rissverk
logoMotifs.prompt: One chunky drawing pen making a smooth curved line connecting two large circular vector anchor nodes. The pen, curve and two nodes are one compact balanced symbol for a drawing/vector editor. No letters or text.
